overall_summary: Data sample is small, but family and relationship dynamics show clear outperformance compared to generic or heavy philosophical topics. Specifically, husband-wife dynamics captured significant outlier views (1645 views), while parent-child bonds consistently pull baseline engagement.

winning_patterns.evidence: Wife emotional video (or5gtaBpRVY) gained 1645 views, and Maa Shayari (OfHrAp3r1G8) gained 225 views, outperforming broader emotional pieces.
winning_patterns.action: Focus heavily on domestic relationships and unsaid emotional burdens between partners and close family.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic or Niche Family Members without Broad Conflict
weak_patterns.evidence: Sister emotional video (jfmMztnam_A) achieved only 17 views under similar publishing conditions.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid purely praise-based or overly niche topics unless anchored to a relatable daily conflict.
